versions.content: As soon as a request message is received (after a call of Dcm_- TpRxIndication with parameter Result = E_OK (see [SWS_Dcm_00093]) and until a call to Dcm_TpTxConfirmation (see [SWS_Dcm_00351]) for the associated Tx- DcmPduId), the DSL submodule shall block the corresponding DcmPduId. During the processing of this request, no other request of the same DcmDslConnection (e.g. an enhanced session can be ended by a OBD session) can be received, until the cor- responding response message is sent and the DcmPduId is released again (except for concurrent TesterPresent requests).
